verses.gurmukhi: ਫੁਲੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: fulee vaas nivaas hai kit jugat samaanee|

en.bdb: The fragrance resides in the flowers but none knows how it takes place there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਜੇ ਇਕ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: falaa a(n)dhar jiau saadh bahu si(n)je ik paanee|

en.bdb: Tastes of the fruits are varied, though the same water irrigates them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਿਉ ਦੁਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: ghiau dhudh vich vakhaaneeaai ko maram na jaanee|

en.bdb: Butter remains in the milk but none understands this mystery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕਾਠ ਵਿਚਿ ਓਹੁ ਅਲਖ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau baisa(n)tar kaaTh vich oh alakh viddaanee|

en.bdb: In the gurmukhs, due to their discipline the realization of authentic self takes place.
For this all, the gurmukh applies the method of love for Guru,
Sangati and the hyms of the Guru, Gurbani
